name: Hana
source:
A youkai that lives in the toilets of a school, she is also a toilet god with extremely high spiritual power.

Although she has no hostile intentions and is not harmful to people, she has a low mental age and sometimes causes problems. Although she looks like a little girl and acts and speaks like a child, she has lived longer than the average human being.
